gryphonne-pattern-chimera.name: Gryphonne Pattern Chimera
gryphonne-pattern-chimera.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 Astra Militarum Infantry models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other Infantry models and each Ogryn model takes the space of 3 other Infantry models.

ryza-pattern-leman-russ-vanquisher-squad.name: Ryza Pattern Leman Russ Vanquisher Squadron

crassus-armoured-assault-vehicle.name: Crassus Armoured Assault Vehicle
crassus-armoured-assault-vehicle.transport: This unit can transport up to 35 friendly Astra Militarum Infantry models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other Infantry models and each Ogryn model takes the space of 3 other Infantry models.

aquila-lander.name: Aquila Lander
aquila-lander.transport: This unit can transport up to 7 friendly Astra Militarum Infantry models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other Infantry models. It cannot transport Ogryn units.

arvus-lighter-squadron.name: Arvus Lighter Squadron
arvus-lighter-squadron.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models. It cannot transport OGRYN units.

banehammer.name: Banehammer
banehammer.transport: This unit can transport up to 25 friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each OGRYN model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

doomhammer.name: Doomhammer
doomhammer.transport: This unit can transport up to 25 friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each OGRYN model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

stormlord.name: Stormlord
stormlord.transport: This unit can transport up to 40 friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each OGRYN model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

taurox.name: Taurox
taurox.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each OGRYN model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

taurox-prime.name: Taurox Prime
taurox-prime.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS or OFFICIO PREFECTUS INFANTRY models.

chimera.name: Chimera
chimera.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each OGRYN model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

centaur-light-carrier.name: Centaur Light Carrier
centaur-light-carrier.transport: This unit can transport up to 5 friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each OGRYN model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

trojan-support-vehicle.name: Trojan Support Vehicle
trojan-support-vehicle.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each OGRYN model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

gorgon-heavy-transporter.name: Gorgon Heavy Transporter
gorgon-heavy-transporter.transport: This unit can transport up to 50 friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each OGRYN model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

deathstrike-missile.name: Deathstrike Missile
deathstrike-missile.text: The Hour Is Now, Missile, One Use Only

fortification-breacher.name: Fortification Breacher
fortification-breacher.text: When this unit makes an attack with its Melta-cutter Drill that targets a Building, add the Destroyer ability to its Melta-cutter Drill for that attack.

siege-weapon-2.name: Siege Weapon
siege-weapon-2.text: This weapon does not suffer any penalties for firing at obscured targets.

lumbering-advance.name: Lumbering Advance
lumbering-advance.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, if it has remained stationary this turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its Dominus Triple Bombard for that action.

marauder-bombs.name: Marauder Bombs
marauder-bombs.text: When this unit finishes making a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll six D6, subtracting 1 from each result if that unit is a Character and adding 1 to each result if that unit is garrisoning a Defensible Terrain feature; for each result of 4+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

praetor-missiles.name: Praetor Missiles
praetor-missiles.text:
When this unit makes a Shoot action, you can choose one of the following:
-- This unit does not suffer any penalties for firing at obscured targets with its Praetor Launcher for this action.
-- Change the range of this unit’s Praetor Launcher to 72" for this action, and add the Anti-air ability to this unit’s
Praetor Launcher for this action.

flanking-manoeuvres.name: Flanking Manoeuvres
flanking-manoeuvres.text: When this units arrives as reinforcements, in addition to the normal Deep Strike restrictions it must be set up wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge.

skyfire.name: Skyfire
skyfire.text: This unit's weapons have the Anti-air ability.

auspex-surveyor.name: Auspex Surveyor
auspex-surveyor.text: At the start of the Action phase, you can select one friendly <Regiment> Vehicle unit within 24" of this unit. Until the end of that phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons by that unit. A unit cannot be targeted by this ability more than once in a turn.

tactical-genius.name: Tactical Genius
tactical-genius.text: If this unit is a Warmaster, and is on the battlefield at the start of the Generate Command Assets step, you generate one extra Command Asset.

astral-divination.name: Astral Divination
astral-divination.text: After this unit makes a Move action, select one friendly LIGHT ASTRA MILITARUM unit within 3" of it. Until the end of the turn, that unit does not suffer the penalty for attacks made with ranged weapons that target obscured targets.

cold-steel-and-courage.name: Cold Steel and Courage
cold-steel-and-courage.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly CATACHAN INFANTRY units whilst they are making Fight actions whilst within 6" of this unit.

down-and-dirty.name: Down and Dirty
down-and-dirty.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit with melee weapons.

its-just-us.name: It's Just Us
its-just-us.text: This unit is never Out of Command: an Out of Command marker is never placed next to it.

colours-of-the-cadian-8th.name: Colours of the Cadian 8th
colours-of-the-cadian-8th.text: You can re-roll Morale tests taken for friendly CADIAN units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

sworn-protector.name: Sworn Protector
sworn-protector.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly LORD CASTELLAN CREED unit within 6" of this unit; remove up to D3 blast markers from that LORD CASTELLAN CREED and place them next to this unit.

hero-of-hades-hive.name: Hero of Hades Hive
hero-of-hades-hive.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units whilst they are within 6" of this unit. Whilst they are within 6" of this unit, you can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units that target ORKS units.

platoon-standard.name: Platoon Standard
platoon-standard.text: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of MILITARUM TEMPESTUS units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS units with a Platoon Standard.

knight-commander.name: Knight Commander
knight-commander.text: If a friendly CADIAN LEMAN RUSS unit starts a Move action within 6" of this unit, that unit can be ordered to go full throttle; add 4" to that unit's Move characteristic whilst making that Move action. A unit can only go full throttle once per turn.

loner.name: Loner
loner.text: This unit cannot be a WARLORD.

demolitions-expert.name: Demolitions Expert
demolitions-expert.text: Once per battle, after this unit makes a Move action, select one enemy unit. Place one blast marker next to that unit.

choir-of-minds.name: Choir of Minds
choir-of-minds.text: When this unit is selected to manifest a psychic power with a range value, add to that value, in inches, the number of models in this unit.

master-of-machines.name: Master of Machines
master-of-machines.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

mindlock.name: Mindlock
mindlock.text: Change this unit’s Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics to 4+ whilst it is within 6" of at least one friendly ASTRA MILITARUM TECH-PRIEST unit.

war-hymns.name: War Hymns
war-hymns.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly ADEPTUS MINISTORUM INFANTRY and ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY units whilst they are making Fight actions whilst within 6" of any friendly units with this ability.

loyal-to-the-end.name: Loyal to the End
loyal-to-the-end.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly LIGHT ASTRA MILITARUM CHARACTER unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 3" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that CHARACTER unit and place them next to this unit.

regimental-standard.name: Regimental Standard
regimental-standard.text: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of <REGIMENT> units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly <REGIMENT> units with a Regimental Standard.

the-hour-is-now.name: The Hour is Now
the-hour-is-now.text: The Deathstrike Missile cannot be fired normally. When this unit makes a Shoot action, if it has not already fired its Deathstrike Missile, roll a D6 and add the turn number. If the result is 5 or more, this unit can shoot with its Deathstrike Missile (for example, during the second turn, a roll of 3 or more would be needed for this unit to shoot with its Deathstrike Missile).

missile.name: Missile
missile.text: When this unit shoots with its Deathstrike Missile, do not make a hit roll for the attack. Instead, select one point on the battlefield within 200" of this unit and place one marker (e.g. a coin) on that point. At the end of the Action phase, roll one D12 for each unit within 6" of that point; on a 3-5 place two blast markers next to the unit being rolled for, on a 6-9 place four blast markers next to the unit being rolled for, and on a 10+ place six blast markers next to the unit being rolled for.

weapons-teams.name: Weapons Teams
weapons-teams.text: For the purposes of determining what models a unit can transport, models in this unit are weapons team models.

tremor.name: Tremor
tremor.text: If a hit roll for an attack made with this weapon against a unit without the Fly keyword is successful, halve that unit’s Move characteristic until the end of that turn.

extended-firing-deck.name: Extended Firing Deck
extended-firing-deck.text: No more than two units can make use of this unit’s Open-topped ability each turn – those units combined can contain no more than 20 models.

leading-from-the-front.name: Leading from the Front
leading-from-the-front.text: You automatically pass Morale tests taken for friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units whilst they are within 6" of this unit and this unit is within 1" of an enemy unit.

officer.name: Officer
officer.text: At the start of the Generate Command Assets step, if this unit is a WARLORD and is on the battlefield, you generate one extra Command Asset.

aura-of-discipline.name: Aura of Discipline
aura-of-discipline.text: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units can use this unit's Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

ecclesiarchy-battle-conclave.name: Ecclesiarchy Battle Conclave
ecclesiarchy-battle-conclave.text: This unit does not take up slots in a Detachment that contains any MINISTORUM PRIESTS.

firing-deck.name: Firing Deck
firing-deck.text: No more than one unit can make use of this unit’s Open-topped ability each turn – that unit can contain no more than 10 models.

artillery-battery.name: Artillery Battery
artillery-battery.text: Each slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to three of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.
